function isCompletionFullDomainLoad(source, options, key) {
  if (options.limit !== void 0 || options.cursor !== void 0 || (options.offset ?? 0) !== 0)
    return false;
  const fields = source === `children` ? [`parent`] : [`rowId`, `id`];
  const onlyDomain = (expression) => {
    if (expression.type === `val`) return true;
    if (expression.type === `ref`)
      return expression.path.length === 1 && fields.includes(String(expression.path[0]));
    return expression.args.every(onlyDomain);
  };
  if (!options.where) return true;
  if (!onlyDomain(options.where)) return false;
  return (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.evaluateReferenceExpression)(
    options.where,
    source === `children` ? { parent: key } : { rowId: key, id: key }
  ) === true;
};
